hero.title: A PIXEL ART STUDIO IN YOUR POCKET.
hero.sub: Draw, animate, and publish pixel art. Free on Android and iOS.
free.title:
FREE. AD-FREE.
OPEN-SOURCE.
free.sub: No ads, no subscriptions, no unlocks. The whole platform is open-source: the app and the server.
free.repo_caption: THE APP AND THE SERVER, BUILT IN THE OPEN
replay.title: YOUR ART DRAWS ITSELF.
replay.sub: Every stroke is recorded. Scrub the replay and export a timelapse as MP4, GIF, or WebP.
replay.strip_caption: THE SAME DRAWING, FIVE MOMENTS OF ITS REPLAY
animation.title:
1,024 FRAMES.
128 LAYERS.
animation.sub: A real animation timeline: per-frame durations, frame-by-frame control, live loop preview.
paint.title: BRUSHES BUILT FOR PIXELS.
paint.sub: Anti-aliased edges when you want them. Three airbrushes. Eight-stop gradients. Single-coat strokes.
patterns.title: DITHER WITH ONE TAP.
patterns.sub: Pick a pattern and every stroke, fill, and erase paints through it. Bayer ladders, lines, bricks, checkers, plus ordered dithering for gradients.
patterns.tiles: 116 TILES, EVERY ONE WITH ITS INVERSE
color.title: REAL RGBA. TEN BLEND MODES.
color.sub: True 8-bit alpha in every pixel. Multiply, Screen, Overlay and more, plus Levels to rescue any import.
select.title:
SELECT IT. SPIN IT.
NO JAGGIES.
select.sub: Rect, oval, and lasso with add, subtract, and intersect. cleanEdge rotation keeps pixel art crisp.
club.title:
DRAW IT.
ANIMATE IT.
SHARE IT.
club.sub: Publish to the Makapix Club, react and comment, remix with public lineage. Free on Android and iOS.
files.title: OPENS EVERYTHING YOU HAVE.
files.sub: Import GIF, PNG, APNG, WebP, JPEG, BMP. Export PNG, GIF, and animated lossless WebP, plus layered .mkpx projects.
banner.title: PIXEL ART STUDIO + COMMUNITY.
